name: n_sheet2
prompt: A character sprite sheet of 3 new villagers for the same cozy island farming game, drawn at EXACTLY the same pixel size, chibi proportions, outline and palette style as the villagers in the reference. Two rows of 3 with generous empty white space between every figure. Row 1: each villager standing still facing the camera. Row 2: the same three villagers in the same order, facing the camera with a slight idle pose change (arms moved, head tilted). The three villagers from left to right: 1) a lean elderly village chief in his sixties with neat grey hair, thick grey eyebrows and small round wire glasses, a light blue short-sleeved shirt under a khaki fishing vest with many pockets, dark trousers and brown shoes, holding a small notebook; 2) a young woman sushi chef in her late twenties with long dark hair in a high ponytail and a white twisted headband, a white chef's jacket with rolled-up sleeves under a dark indigo apron, black trousers and wooden sandals; 3) a small energetic boy about eight years old, clearly SHORTER than the two adults (about three quarters of their height), messy brown hair, a big gap-toothed grin, an oversized mustard yellow t-shirt with a small fish print, blue shorts, sandals, holding a little red bucket.
